description: A zero-capture regex result is read at index one, which is statically undefined even after checking that exec returned a match. The controls establish each boundary: positional and named captures make index one valid, index zero is the whole match, a runtime pattern has no static arity, and a reassigned result uses its latest definition.

expected.note: the ternary checks that exec matched, but successful matches still have no element one because the pattern defines zero captures
